retained.role: Official structured GSAM/GSAR agency-supplement source for deterministic FAR -> agency supplement resolution.
implementation_evidence: Exact DITA source dita/552.204-9.dita encodes GSAR clause identifier/title, prescribing section 504.1303, revision text (Apr 2023), structured paragraphs and subcontract flowdown.
Repository is an official GSA Acquisition.gov publication surface with DITA plus rendered publication artifacts.
limitations: Repository currentness still must be tied to the controlling solicitation/effective source and deviations.
Similarly numbered clauses across FAR/DFARS/agency supplements require namespace-aware resolution.
retained.first_paid_wedge: Agency-specific rule/readiness section inside CaptureBrief for GSA opportunities with exact source/prescription lineage.

retained.role: Corpus-scale SAM entity/exclusion acquisition with cache-first enrichment, artifact hashing, source manifests and explicit source-coverage limits.
implementation_evidence: sam_extract.py implements asynchronous SAM Entity Extract submit/download, gzip/zip/plain sniffing, 1,000,000-record cap handling, state partition fallback, cache-first UEI enrichment and quota-aware two-step download.
provenance.py persists request/source metadata, fetch time, record count and SHA-256; API keys are redacted before persistence.
The code explicitly documents public-key coverage gaps such as absent FOUO parent/POC fields rather than interpreting absence as negative evidence.
limitations: SAM/API service behavior and source terms remain external authority.
Public-key source omissions cannot support negative conclusions about restricted fields or parent hierarchy.
retained.first_paid_wedge: Evidence-grade vendor/entity snapshot layer for CaptureBrief or vendor due diligence, with reproducible bulk-source manifests.

retained.role: Explainable federal recompete/incumbent signal layer over normalized award history; useful for pre-solicitation prioritization but not source authority.
implementation_evidence: mart_recompete_candidates.sql computes named SQL components for recompete and incumbent scores, exposing the component breakdown rather than a black-box model.
sql/analysis.sql includes explicit artifact traps, placebo-control backtests, repeated scope-expansion checks and documented look-ahead bias.
The 2026-09-14 Treasury expansion commit reports near-window incumbent retention ~30.5% versus placebo ~11.4% after scope expansion.
A separate commit measured and deliberately excluded GSA because its source shape would swamp the radar, rather than forcing a larger but misleading corpus.
limitations: No explicit predecessor->successor award link exists; follow-on matching is inferred and noisy.
Current lifetime_obligated creates look-ahead bias in historical retention analysis.
Award summaries do not provide modification history, and the score itself has known saturation limits.
Use as prioritization evidence only; never as proof that a solicitation will occur.
retained.first_paid_wedge: Agency/NAICS-specific recompete watchlist with incumbent lineage, explicit score components and scope caveats.

integration_rule: Keep authority/evidence infrastructure separate from predictive decision signals. Recompete-radar may prioritize review but cannot establish current solicitation or regulatory authority.
